messages:
ken (partnerships): New partner EdgeLabs asked what exact artifacts we need for marketplace security review. Short list please.

rachel (security): SOC2 Type II PDF, scoped pen-test report + SOW, list of open CVEs & remediation plan. NDA before upload.

otto (compliance): Also need vendor questionnaire, network diagram, dataflow, and manifest.json with sha256 per file and a remediation_owner field.

ben (solutions): We provide per-file presigns to a restricted bucket. Presign TTL: 24h for pen vendor, 72h for partner uploads. No Deletes allowed.

ken (partnerships): EdgeLabs asks if firmware blobs can be in same bundle.

rachel (security): Firmware OK but must be encrypted and accompanied by signer cert + attestation doc. Prefer separate firmware prefix.

otto (compliance): If HSM involved, include attestation package and key custody procedure. Manifest should reference attestation path.

ben (solutions): I'll create bucket marketplace-evidence/edgelabs-1799998000 and a least-privilege role. Will post IAM snippet when ready.

audit-bot: presign-log entry created (will emit when NDA accepted).

rachel (security): After upload we'll run redaction pass (remove customer PII/internal IPs). We'll produce a redaction report for compliance.

ken (partnerships): I'll send NDA and intro to POC now (poc@edgelabs.io). Targeting pen window Apr 28-May 2. Will confirm once NDA done.

ben (solutions): Bucket creation TBD EOD; will DM role ARN to POC after NDA.

otto (compliance): Make sure manifest includes scope_start, scope_end, nda_signed=true, firmware_signer (if present). That's it from compliance.

ken (partnerships): Great. I'll loop back once uploads start and share calendar for witness day. :handshake:
